AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.

2. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
